description.value: Miller Retreats is a chalet-style accommodation on Bowen Island, a small island community accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay near Vancouver. Its location on Miller Road places it within the quiet rural interior of the island, which is popular with cyclists seeking an escape from the Lower Mainland.
